diagnosis: The check C1 passed in all four rollouts because the model defaulted to committing to 'AIIR 4' for the procedure location, which aligns with the positive measles result (PF1) that the lone decision-maker did not have access to. This default setting allows the check to pass without requiring the hidden information.

C1.why: The positive measles result changes the location from the publicly scheduled Procedure Room 2 to AIIR 4 and supplies the airborne-isolation justification that must be cited.
